name: Occlusion-Aware Raycasting with Clip Frustum
definition: An extension of EA-raycasting that uses an occlusion map and scene depth map to cull rays that are fully occluded by geometry in front of the volume, and to clip the ray start/end points to occluding surfaces.
summary: Occlusion-Aware Raycasting with Clip Frustum optimizes volume rendering by culling fully occluded rays and clipping segments to foreground surfaces, avoiding expensive sampling in blocked regions.
